genericProblem: A managed browser proof clicks a data-backed Ant Design Select before its asynchronous owner result has materialized in the rendered popup, then targets a semantic option shape that is not the rendered option content.
finiteDenominator: the shared platform workspace Select helper
the shared platform finite-option Select helper
all managed platform specs that consume those helpers
searchedSurfaces: the fresh platform Playwright trace and network response
counterexamples: a static Select with synchronously present options can use its approved rendered option locator without an asynchronous owner-readback wait
an independently provisioned test control with a documented stable role option is outside this Ant Design virtual-list denominator

findings.evidence: The owner group-workspaces response was HTTP 200 with the fixture label, while the trace showed the popup empty at the click boundary and the old role locator never matched the rendered .ant-select-item-option-content.
findings.minimumFix: Wait for the visible popup option-content node and click that rendered node in both shared helpers; keep the owner query and IA single-select behavior unchanged.
